The '''Carest system''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories galactically north of the [[Vaathkree Trade Corridor/Legends|Vaathkree Trade Corridor]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained [[Carest 1]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Jiivahar]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
